ConvNets vary in the number of convolutional layers, ranging from shallow architectures with just one convolutional layer such as in a successful speech recognition ConvNet over deep ConvNets with multiple consecutive convolutional layers to very deep architectures with more than 1000 layers as in the case of the recently developed residual networks .

To address these questions, we created three ConvNets with different architectures, with the number of convolutional layers ranging from 2 layers in a "shallow" ConvNet over a 5-layer deep ConvNet up to a 31-layer residual network (ResNet).
